differences.title: 1. DATABASE MODEL
differences.leftDesc: Tigris unifies structured, unstructured, and vector data in one engine, simplifying data access and enabling hybrid search capabilities seamlessly.
differences.rightDesc: MongoDB Atlas excels with its flexible, schema-less document model, ideal for evolving application data structures and complex queries.

differences.title: 2. VECTOR SEARCH
differences.leftDesc: Tigris provides built-in vector search with ACID guarantees, ensuring data consistency and transactional integrity for AI-driven applications.
differences.rightDesc: Atlas offers vector search via extensions, requiring careful management for transactional consistency and potentially complex application-level handling.

differences.title: 3. SERVERLESS ARCHITECTURE
differences.leftDesc: Tigris automatically scales compute and storage based on load, eliminating manual provisioning and optimizing cost for unpredictable workloads.
differences.rightDesc: Atlas offers managed clusters that require sizing and configuration, providing control but demanding more operational oversight.

differences.title: 4. TRANSACTIONAL GUARANTEES
differences.leftDesc: Tigris enforces strict ACID compliance across all operations, guaranteeing data integrity and reliability for critical business logic.
differences.rightDesc: Atlas offers tunable consistency levels, allowing for trade-offs between performance and immediate data accuracy in distributed scenarios.

differences.title: 5. DATA MODIFICATION
differences.leftDesc: Tigris uses strict schema enforcement to ensure data quality and predictable performance, simplifying development and reducing errors.
differences.rightDesc: Atlas offers optional schema validation rules, providing flexibility but requiring developers to manage data integrity carefully.

differences.title: 6. INDEXING STRATEGY
differences.leftDesc: Tigris automatically manages indexes and supports hybrid search indexes, optimizing performance for diverse query patterns.
differences.rightDesc: Atlas requires manual index creation and tuning for specific query needs, offering granular control.

differences.title: 7. DEVELOPMENT FOCUS
differences.leftDesc: Tigris prioritizes a seamless developer experience with a unified API and serverless model, accelerating time-to-market.
differences.rightDesc: Atlas offers deep operational control and customization for experienced DBAs and infrastructure teams.
